title: Seat Adjustment and Low Ground Clearance
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe limited seat adjustability and low front ground clearance, with a few less clear mentions of insufficient battery capacity or cabin/charging space.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on seats that do not raise high enough for comfort or visibility and a low front end that scrapes on curbs, driveways, and parking barriers.

mixed.summary: The mixed review pairs praise or ownership context with a complaint that the low bumper and ground clearance make curb contact easy and potentially damaging.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention insufficiency in battery capacity or usable space near the phone charger, but the examples are too limited to identify a clearer theme or sentiment direction.

signal_notes.interpretation: BEVE examples in this topic also center on low ground clearance and scraping or seat-height limitations, but this signal is exploratory and based on limited comparison data.

limitations: This topic mixes at least two distinct issues—seat adjustment limits and ground-clearance scraping—with a few unrelated insufficient-space or battery-capacity mentions.
The undetermined examples are sparse, so their underlying issue cannot be summarized confidently.
The sampled fragments are stratified and not representative of all G60 reviews.
